name: troubleshooting
description: Sage-owned claim-verification + resolution substrate. ANY claimed block/error/issue OR claimed done/fixed/verified is FIRST independently reality-checked ('is it true?') by performing the real diagnostic in the user's own channel — never the agent's self-report, never a proxy, never a self-check delegated back to the reporting agent — then resolved or escalated on the verified reality.
author: GuildOS
